operator_level_dedup: Umsonst & viel für wenig and MehrWertKultur are both operated by contraZt e.V. and count as one supplier operator. The media-focused MehrWertKultur location is not counted separately from the clothing second-hand shop.
reason: Independent PASS2 confirms a current Hamburg nonprofit second-hand shop operator. contraZt e.V.'s current first-party site explicitly states it operates the Umsonstladen 'Umsonst & viel für wenig', where the public can obtain second-hand clothing for adults and children together with textiles and household goods; March 2026 pages confirm current operation and donation intake. The first-party imprint identifies contraZt e.V., Hamburg Vereinsregister 18335 and representative André Jobst. The operation is public-facing but no current item-level remote apparel catalogue, direct remote checkout or ordinary delivery to Spain is established, so the operator is VERIFIED_HOLD rather than ELIGIBLE.
